body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: d49e8f12b7ad7b62272731edd4fd8975cda9cc2f -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review because the change affects geometry.

What looks good:
- The planner can try one finer chord. The requested tolerance does not change.
- The minimum chord, triangle limit, cancellation checks, and mesh acceptance checks stay in place.
- The sample test checks all 53 faces, positive volume, no open sides, and measured deviation within tolerance.
- The decision record explains the change and the limits of the measurement.

Local build and test results:
- Reviewed head: `d49e8f12b7ad7b62272731edd4fd8975cda9cc2f`.
- Upstream main: `d1484f02a359eb496803630f36575897a88f75ee`.
- The trial merge in `.claude/worktrees/review-1930` reported `Already up to date.` The PR contains this main commit.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. One library test and seven machining-mesh tests passed. One release bench test stayed ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-kernel --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Separate runs of both Solidcraft sample tests and the geometry mutation test passed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`: passed.

The accepted sample has 279,600 triangles and 53 faces. Its measured deviation is 0.003230904532072524 mm at the requested 0.005 mm tolerance. The report records a planning chord of 0.0025 mm. At a requested 0.1 mm tolerance, the sample is still refused: face 36 measures 0.13365682857055464 mm.

Mutation checks:
I ran `the_deviation_measure_sees_a_moved_node_and_a_wrong_surface` separately. This test changes geometry in memory. It does not edit source files.
1. Move a shared edge node by 0.1 mm. RED condition detected: parametric deviation exceeds 0.05 mm. The unchanged control has deviation below 1e-9 mm. GREEN: the test passed.
2. Move the record's plane by 0.1 mm. RED condition detected: analytic deviation exceeds 0.09 mm and identifies face 0, while parametric deviation stays below 1e-9 mm. GREEN: the test passed.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:
- No golden files, NC files, CL files, or snapshot images changed.
- No UI files changed. Before and after screenshots are not required for this change.
- No dependencies, build scripts, scripts, or workflow files changed.
- Cargo reported future compatibility warnings for the existing `nom` and `quick-xml` dependencies.
- The heavy release bench and end-to-end posting were not run. The sampled deviation check does not prove the continuous maximum distance.
- The PR author's source rollback mutation was not repeated. The two mutation checks above use the existing geometry test.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
